meta.title: QarQal: Compare car insurance from up to 10 insurers
meta.description: Compare motor insurance quotes from up to 10 insurers and get 24/7 towing in one app. Road tax, licence and JPJ summons coming soon. For cars and motorbikes in Malaysia.

brand.tagline: Bespoke app for all your vehicle needs

hero.title: Compare car insurance from up to 10 insurers, right on your phone.
hero.subtitle: Pick your cover, add the extras you want, and pay in the QarQal app. 24/7 towing is in there too, with road tax coming soon.

quote.title: Get your car insurance quote
quote.consent: By continuing, you agree QarQal may use these details to prepare your quote.

errors.nric: Enter the 12 digits on your MyKad.
errors.passport: Use letters and numbers only (up to 20).
errors.company: Use letters, numbers and dashes only (up to 20).
errors.plate: Enter a valid plate number, e.g. WXY 1234.
errors.server: We couldn't get your quote just now. Please try again, or continue in the app.

quote.doneTitle: Your quotes are waiting in the app
quote.doneBody: Download QarQal and enter these details to compare up to 10 insurers side by side.

points.title: Earn QarQal points
points.body: Add your mobile number and earn QarQal points when you buy your insurance. We'll send you a 6-digit code.
points.invalid: Enter a valid Malaysian mobile number, e.g. 12 345 6789.
points.failed: We couldn't send the code. Please try again.
points.blocked: This number can't be used. Please use another number or skip.

otp.title: Enter your code
otp.invalid: Enter the 6 digits from your code.
otp.wrong: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.

quoteFlow.loading: Comparing insurers for you… this can take up to 30 seconds.

results.title: Choose your plan
results.notEarning: You're not earning points on this purchase.
results.noneForCover: No insurer quoted this cover online. Try another cover type.
results.notFound: We couldn't find an insurer for this vehicle. Check the plate and ID number, or continue in the app.
results.error: We couldn't get your quotes just now. Please try again.
results.lede: Pick an insurer and add the extras you want. The price updates as you choose.
results.priceNote: Tiles show the gross contribution. Your total to pay, with SST and stamp duty, is in the order summary and is confirmed when you select an insurer.
results.notFoundTitle: No insurer found for this vehicle

editConfirm.title: Change your vehicle details?
editConfirm.body: You'll go back to the home page to enter your vehicle and ID details again, and get new quotes. The choices you made on this page won't be kept.

page.missing: This quote is no longer available on this device. Start a new quote to see prices again.

details.title: Your details
details.failed: We couldn't save your details. Please check them and try again.
details.lookupsFailed: Some lists didn't load. Refresh the page and try again.
details.errName: Enter your full name (at least 3 letters).
details.lede: The policy will be issued in this name, so enter the details as they appear on the ID.

payment.title: Review and pay
payment.totalNote: Billplz shows the final amount before you pay.
payment.failed: We couldn't start the payment. Please try again.
payment.secure: You'll pay on Billplz's secure page, then come back here.
payment.lede: Check your order, then pay securely with Billplz.

result.successBody: Thank you. Your payment went through and we're issuing your policy now.
result.failedBody: Your payment didn't go through and you haven't been charged. You can try again.
result.unknownBody: We couldn't confirm your payment status. If you were charged, your policy is still being issued.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.none: This insurer has no add-ons online.
addons.failed: We couldn't update the price with this add-on. Remove it or try again.
addons.resetNote: Your add-ons were reset because the value type changed. Add them again if you need them.

drivers.title: Additional named drivers
drivers.price: Up to {max}. First driver free, then RM {price} each.
drivers.errName: Enter the driver's full name (at least 3 letters).

success.title: Yay, you're in!
success.body: You'll earn QarQal points on {mobile} when you buy your insurance.
success.guestTitle: Your quotes are on the way
success.guestBody: We're comparing insurers for you. While you wait, get the QarQal app.
success.closing: This closes by itself in {s} seconds

plan.title: Plan
plan.marketHelp: A claim pays the car's market value at the time of loss.
plan.agreedHelp: A claim pays the amount agreed today.
plan.sumRange: Must be between RM {min} and RM {max}.
plan.roadTaxHelp: Renew your road tax together with this policy.

quoteFlow.earnInApp: Download the QarQal app to earn points

trust.disclaimer: Insurance quotes are provided through our partner Senang, an insurance aggregator.
trust.rakanNiaga: Official JPJ Rakan Niaga, by MOT

oldWay.title: Still chasing your agent for a quote?
oldWay.body: You message your agent and wait. You check one insurer's website, then another. Road tax is on a different portal, and the towing number is somewhere in your glovebox. QarQal puts all of it in one app.

steps.title: Add your vehicle
steps.body: Save your car or motorbike in Qarqal Garage once. Its details stay there for next year's renewal.

steps.title: Compare quotes
steps.body: See prices from up to 10 insurers side by side, then add the extras you want.

steps.title: Pay in the app
steps.body: Pay through a licensed Malaysian payment gateway. Your policy is issued by the insurer you chose.

calc.title: Work out your costs before you renew
calc.lede: Estimate your car insurance, road tax and car loan. Exact prices from each insurer are in the app.

result.taxNote: Every Malaysian motor policy adds service tax on the premium plus stamp duty. The figure shown above is the premium before both.

calc.limitBody: Get unlimited calculations and exact prices from up to 10 insurers in the QarQal app.
calc.appNudge: Exact prices from each insurer and renewal are in the QarQal app.

errors.downPayment: The down payment must be less than the car price.
errors.server: We couldn't calculate this just now. Please try again.
errors.config: The calculator couldn't load. Please refresh the page.
errors.slowDown: Too many tries in a short time. Please wait a moment and try again.

car.placeholder: Select your car to estimate sum insured
car.noEstimate: We can't estimate this car's market value yet. Enter the sum insured below.
car.outOfRange: The estimated value ({value}) is outside the insurable range. Enter the sum insured below.
car.loadError: Couldn't load the car list. Please try again.

assist.title: Stuck on the highway at 2am? Qarqal Assist sends a tow truck.
assist.body: 24/7 towing and breakdown help with Basic or Premium plans, for cars and motorbikes, including EVs and superbikes.

basic.name: Basic
basic.desc: Towing when you break down, at a lower price.
points: 100 km of towing for your vehicle, anywhere in Malaysia
Use it up to 3 times within 365 days of purchase

premium.name: Premium
premium.desc: Our full plan: longer towing, no limit on use, and extra help when things go wrong.
points: 300 km of towing, anywhere in Malaysia

extras.title: Flood towing
extras.body: Special towing when your car is caught in a flood.

extras.title: Tyre, battery and fuel delivery
extras.body: Delivery only. You pay for the items.

extras.title: Jump-start
extras.body: No extra charge. You pay for a new battery if yours has failed.

extras.title: Funeral compensation
extras.body: RM1,000 in the event of the member’s death.

assist.terms: Benefits vary by plan. T&C apply.
assist.link: See Assist plans in the app
assist.hint: Tap a plan to see what’s included.

more.title: Road tax, licence and JPJ summons, coming soon in one app
more.lede: As an official JPJ Rakan Niaga, QarQal is bringing these JPJ services online. Download now and they'll be ready the day they go live.

roadtax.title: Road tax renewal
points: Renew online, any time of day
Do it right after your insurance renewal

jpj.title: Government services
jpj.body: Driving licence renewal and more JPJ services are coming to the app. Download now and you'll have it the day it goes live.
jpj.leadRest: by the Ministry of Transport (MOT) Malaysia, with authorization from the Ministry of Finance (MOF) as a collection agent.

items.a: Yes, the app is free to download.
The insurer you choose. QarQal gets your quotes through Senang, our insurance aggregator partner.

items.q: Is paying in the app safe?
items.a: Payments go through licensed Malaysian payment gateways.

items.q: Does it cover motorbikes and company cars?
items.a: Yes: cars, motorbikes and company-registered vehicles.

A business partner appointed by the Ministry of Transport (MOT) to provide JPJ services. QarQal is an official JPJ Rakan Niaga, with authorization from the Ministry of Finance (MOF) as a collection agent.
